reviews.t: Product is everything it advertises, but beware if you have fragrance alleriges

claims.text: Many reviewers say it works well as a cleansing conditioner, leaving hair soft, manageable, and easy to detangle.
Several reviewers find it a cheaper alternative to WEN and say it performs as well or better.
Multiple reviewers warn that the price on this listing is much higher than at local stores like Walmart or Walgreens.
A few reviewers report it left natural hair dry and frizzy, though one later realized the problem was something else.
Some reviewers with different hair types, including white/fine or frizzy hair, also found it helpful.
